verdict.rationale: Bevy documents asset hot-reloading (scenes, textures, meshes) and touts 'instant feedback... without app restarts or recompiles' plus fast compile times (0.8–3.0s), which shortens the edit-run loop, but Bevy games are compiled Rust, not scripted, so there's no evidence of true script-level hot reload equivalent to interpreted-language workflows. missing for 10: evidence of hot-reloading actual game logic/code (not just assets), independent hands-on confirmation of the 'instant feedback' claim, and any scripting-language integration for non-recompile logic changes.
